facts.fact: The Electronic Government Act, 2021 (Act No. 41 of 2021, an act of Parliament, assented 19 May 2021) is an enacted e-government law whose own text provides for public bodies sharing data: s.12(3) lets a public body retrieve documents from the issuing public body with the data subject's consent, and s.17 provides for joint automated procedures between public bodies.

The Electronic Government Act, 2021 (Act No. 41 of 2021) only permits sharing between public bodies: s.12(3) says a public body 'may' retrieve documents from another public body with consent, and s.17(1) says it 'may' implement joint automated procedures; neither obliges exchange or connection, and no regulation made under it is mentioned.
